title: Find out how many times has an array been rotated
problemStatement: Determine how many times a sorted array has been rotated.
intuition: The rotation count equals the index of the minimum element, so this is problem #88 returning an index.

approaches.title: Optimal: pivot index search
approaches.idea: Same converge-on-pivot loop, return the index.

commonMistakes: Returning the value instead of the index
Assuming left rotation when the problem means right
patternRecognition: Restating a problem as a known one is often the entire solution
followUps: Rotate the array back in O(1) space
Search in the rotated array using the pivot
interviewInsight: Clarify the rotation direction before coding; the off-by-one differs.
